name: Gemini 3.5 Flash Cyber
description: Google DeepMind's specialized cybersecurity model, built to help defenders find, validate, and patch software vulnerabilities quickly and efficiently. Gemini 3.5 Flash Cyber is fine-tuned from the Gemini 3.5 Flash base model with deep expertise in vulnerability research, security analysis, exploit validation, and patch generation. It enables security teams to dramatically accelerate their defensive workflows compared to general-purpose LLMs.
keyFeatures: Specialized for cybersecurity: vulnerability detection, validation, and patching
Designed to help defenders — not exploit — with a safety-first approach
Fine-tuned from Gemini 3.5 Flash with deep security domain expertise
Accelerates security workflows: from vulnerability identification to patch generation
Supports code analysis across multiple languages for CVE detection and remediation
curatorNotes: Released July 21, 2026. Authors: Raluca Ada Popa and Four Flynn. First Google model explicitly specialized for cybersecurity defense use cases. Available via Google AI Studio and API.
